visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with long black hair, a pink hair clip, and a white graphic t-shirt sits on a light-colored floor. She smiles and reaches out to a small boy wearing a brown and white shirt, pulling him into her lap against a plain white wall. (2) The girl picks up a large yellow pomelo peel that has been cut into a cap with several long, tentacle-like strips. She carefully places the pomelo hat onto the boy's head while he smiles widely at the camera. (3) The girl puts a matching pomelo peel hat on her own head. She wraps her arms around the boy, and they both pose together, looking directly at the lens in a brightly lit room with soft shadows. (4) A cross-fade transition introduces a warm-toned, filtered image of the same girl from a younger age holding a baby, both wearing identical pomelo hats. Text markers '2022' and '2025' appear on screen to indicate the time lapse. (5) The final sequence shows a centered text overlay wishing a happy festival while the girl and the now older boy continue to smile and celebrate their family tradition together.
